checks.why: The true build's room registry carries the Smart Factory room. Measured 2026-10-22: true build 6 occurrences, stale monolith 0.
Current look/feel design token from the same room registry. Measured: true build 2, stale monolith 0.

The Smart Note wall is baked into the true build as note records carrying topic lists. Measured: true build 288 records (Nitro's restore count), stale monolith 0 — its only notes are 10 cards in a snapshot block.
Independent wall corroboration: distinct Smart Note ids in the served shell. Measured: true build 208 unique, stale monolith 11.
The true build (shell + baked wall) is ~2.09 MB; the stale monolith shell is ~0.52 MB. A served shell that collapses to half size has lost the wall, whatever its markers say.

The Mission room script wiring exists ONLY in the repo monolith build (it was the #2961 payload). The canonical lane build carries no such script tag. If reconciliation ever lands this room in the canonical build legitimately, remove this marker in that same change.
The lane build serves a real, distinct Reports room document with this title. Under the stale monolith worker, this URL returns the app shell (title 'NayaNET — The Intelligent Hub') via SPA fallback.
The snapshot-shell marker must never appear as a room document. Measured: real Reports room 0 occurrences, stale monolith shell 10.
A worker that serves the identical bytes for a room route as for the home route is serving a fallback shell, not the room. The real room document differs from the home shell.

notes: Identity expectations for the TRUE canonical Hub build served at nayanet.live. Every value below was measured against the restored lane build and the stale repo monolith on 2026-10-22 (see hidden evidence: hub-notes-vanished/DIAGNOSIS.md). When the canonical build legitimately changes, update the affected markers IN THE SAME CHANGE and note the date — a sentinel whose expectations describe a build that no longer exists alarms honestly, and that alarm is the signal to update this file, never to silence the sentinel.

When the wall checks fail AND this block is what the served home page carries instead, the served build is named as the stale monolith rather than an unknown build.
